mapping.homecoord_ms_to_backend_ticks: 1 logical millisecond = 1 SimuHome tick at 1 ms/tick
mapping.duration_note: HomeCoord action duration is held in its event timeline; SimuHome commands change device state immediately.

rows.interpretation: Backend state replay of saved HomeCoord actions. The HomeCoord evaluator applies action effects at start; SimuHome evolves HVAC room state over time. Raw thermal values are uncalibrated.
